tool_call_format: xml <tool_call><function=NAME><parameter=KEY>value</parameter></function></tool_call> blocks; tool definitions as JSON lines in a <tools> block in the system message
known_template_errors: Unexpected message role. (developer role, or any role other than system/user/assistant/tool)
System message must be at the beginning. (a system message that is not messages[0])
No user query found in messages. (no user role anywhere in messages)
notes:
reasoning_effort is never referenced by the template, so all six levels render byte-identical to a plain call: silently ignored, not accepted and not rejected. enable_thinking=false renders an empty ' thinking

</think>

' block after the assistant header; true or absent renders ' thinking
'. A developer role raises, but llama.cpp b11960 maps developer to system before rendering (chat.cpp:1517), so the server path works. With tools, the tool block replaces the system turn and any leading system content is appended after </IMPORTANT>. llama.cpp caps will report supports_reasoning_effort=false for this template (caps.cpp:569-593).
